reviews.text: Great service. The nice lady always asks me about Mariel, my cat, and gave her a treat on her 15th birthday :)  Thank you
Dilara is wonderful to deal with. Very nice and pleasant.
This is a great place to purchase animal food and accessories! Super great prices and they are warm and welcoming :)

A can of cat food fell out of the 12-can package when it was delivered, and I didn't even notice until their delivery guy deliberately brought back that 1 can to me the following day! I'm impressed 💯👍🏻 …

Bad experience. After ate one of the wet can food brought from this store, my dog had diarrhea. I called this store asked for a refund on this purchase. I was told by the stuff, “no, it’s your dog’s allergies, this does not qualified for our refund policy.”
My dog has no allergies with turkey and she ate other turkey products just fine!
VERY DISAPPOINTING!!!! Will not come back! This is my first bad review ever to any places.
Good selection for cats & dogs. They are well stocked with raw food and kibble. Excellent service too!

The staff here are so friendly and welcoming. They are also very knowledgeable especially when it comes to the healthier foods for our 4 legged family members ❤️
If yours is like mine has a sensitive tummy come here, they will get you and your furry loved one sorted out ❤️
I am a first time dog owner. Lara was very helpful in choosing right stuff for my puppy.
We order our dog food in and the staff are always great, but today Lara went above & beyond to make sure our pup was taken care of, so much appreciation for this small business! Thank you :-)
Love the donburi, rice is nice and soft, tempura is fresh and crispy. This is my comfort food place.
Cute store, helpful sales associate. Appreciate it being open in the early evenings.
They are great and so helpful!  I love that they deliver too!
awesome place for pet supplies

I came here omw to Mums and felt like coming home "the hero" to my two Chihuahuas with some special treats... needless to say, these little "love and fishes" dried sardines were a hit. Thank you to the wonderful woman helping me figure out what the best idea for the little guys would be ideal 🐕🐕 …

I have been going to Pet Pantry on Main since they opened. They carry two types of food that I can't find, or have trouble finding, elsewhere. My pup and I are especially fond of Lara, who works there.  She has been helpful over the years, providing detailed information about various lines of food for my picky eater pup., and when I sought out more Canadian brands. Lara also offered to reach out to one of the food companies when I had a quality control issue with one of my pup's favourite treats.  I really appreciated that.  My pup has taken to dragging me there a couple of times a week to score a free treat in his middle age. Lara is always very kind and obliging.
Wonderful customer service. I always find the ideal food for my cats as their favorite toys

This is my go-to, local pet store, they have everything a pet owner needs and we have been going here at least 6 years. The manager is always so nice and great at recommending products and letting us know of deals (there are always a specials going on). They have 1 parking spot in the back and I love their points system too. They did offer free delivery a while back during COVID but I'm not sure if they still do. I only used that service once but best you call and confirm. There are several locations in Vancouver which I have not gone to, buy being family owned I am confident they are just as good. Anyways, five stars!!!
Have been getting pet food here for years!
Very good selection of food and treats; very friendly and knowledgeable staff, prepared to go the extra mile; convenient location. Highly recommended.
Lara was really great at helping me narrow down the choices with my cat food!
Lovely customer service, very helpful and knowledgeable, very flexible. Highly recommend
Helpful staff!
We buy our dog’s frozen raw food here. Pick up or free delivery which is sometimes really handy.
Knowledgeable and super friendly staff. Nice selection of quality products. Excellent service.

Very helpful staff with a great selection. Helped me pick out some low/single ingredient treats for my dog and a product to clean his ears with. I also found this adorable toy that’s literally a bubble bath with a rubber ducky in it. I will definitely be back!!
Amazing!!
Best pet store in town. Great deals and super staff.
